capabilities: Highlight English words based on word frequency
Adjust the highlight frequency threshold and per-range colors in settings
Disable individual highlight groups to focus on specific frequency ranges
Toggle highlighting on or off with a command
extras: README notes that files must be reopened in Reading View for highlight changes to appear; the screenshots section contained only images, which are not described in text.
motivation: To enhance reading and learning in Obsidian by highlighting words based on their frequency, aiding English language learning and content review.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visually mark vocabulary by word frequency while reading notes for language learning.
summary: Frequency-based highlighter that colors English words in reading view according to how common each word is.
